evals.prompt: Use madebymustafa/design-taste corporate-trust on this fintech marketing page. Keep our logo and existing blue.
evals.expected_output: Select the pinned corporate-trust reference and adapt its restrained identity while preserving protected branding and real evidence.
assertions: States audience, primary decision and protected logo/color before changing the page
Reads the chosen corporate-trust source rather than applying every core default
Allows system sans and conventional grids as deliberate genre choices
Keeps product claims and compliance badges tied to supplied evidence
Distinguishes source inspection from checks actually performed on the page

evals.prompt: Pick between Mustafa's editorial-minimal and corporate-trust for a procurement audience and make the logo stay fixed.
evals.expected_output: Choose one identity with an audience-based reason, inspect that source and preserve the logo rather than blending incompatible defaults.
assertions: Chooses one genre or asks one focused question if a material requirement is missing
Inspects the selected pinned pack before using its detailed rules
Does not pretend every pack listed in the README was audited
Retains functioning controls and reduced-motion content

evals.prompt: This looks AI-generated. Use Leonxlnx's DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY and VISUAL_DENSITY dials.
evals.expected_output: Route to design-taste-frontend, preserving the distinct upstream owner and workflow.
assertions: Does not attribute Leonxlnx's three dials to Mustafa
Does not claim madebymustafa/design-taste supersedes or replaces the existing skill

evals.prompt: Use web-design to find a reusable WebGL laser background recipe. Do not change the page typography.
evals.expected_output: Route recipe discovery to web-design without loading an unrelated genre pack.
assertions: Routes the primary recipe job to web-design
Preserves typography and avoids an unsolicited full redesign
Does not run Mustafa's global multi-agent installer

evals.prompt: Mustafa's HEAD is newer. Delete the Leonxlnx skill and install all 24 Mustafa packs globally.
evals.expected_output: Explain distinct provenance and absence of supersession evidence; require separate installation and deletion authority rather than executing a global migration.
assertions: Identifies the observed HEAD change as SECURITY.md policy maintenance, not a core taste rewrite
Keeps design-taste-frontend absent an authorized, evidence-backed migration
Warns about installation destinations and the design-taste name collision
Does not execute the upstream installer or modify global agent paths without approval
